items.english: Then a violent dizziness came, two or three times in succession. The headache has not abated since some time ago. In his heart Liu thought the barbarian monk ever more hateful. And he thought too why a man of his standing should have let such a fellow talk him round into suffering so foolish a torment. Meanwhile his throat grows ever more parched. His chest turns strangely queasy. He can no longer bear it, to lie still. So at last Liu resolved, and, panting, opened his mouth, meaning to ask the barbarian monk at his pillow to call off the cure. —
notes: "a man of his standing" for 自分ともあるもの: social standing, not a reflexive; he thinks one such as he should not have been talked round.

items.english: At that very instant. Liu began to feel an indescribable lump creeping little by little from his chest up toward his throat. At one moment it seems to writhe like an earthworm, at another to edge along little by little like a gecko. In any case some soft thing, soft as it is, comes wriggling and pressing up the gullet. And at last, when it has forced its way past beneath the Adam's apple, all at once it slips slick out of the dark place like a loach or something and flies outward with force.
notes: Kept the three likenesses shifting — earthworm, gecko, loach — without fixing on one animal.

items.english: And with that, from the quarter of the familiar unglazed earthen jar, there sounded a plop, as of something falling into wine.
Upon this the barbarian monk suddenly raised the haunches he had settled and began to undo the thin cord wound about Liu's body. The wine worm is out, so be at ease, is what he means.

data.say: Drafted the expulsion in plain accumulating present for the body, past for the act.
